fixture_corpus.why_not_runtime_hashing: hashes computed at launcher run time would verify the fixture against itself. The chain that carries evidentiary weight is: development source -> frozen fixture bytes -> committed fixture SHA registry -> rehearsal. The expected value must exist BEFORE the rehearsal invocation admitted as evidence.

purpose: the object-identity registry for the CLOSED-LATCH FIXTURE REHEARSAL. It exercises the orchestration topology and the governance classification. It NEVER touches S3 and no credential path exists for it.
sha256_are_fixture_hashes: the sha256 values are hashes of the LOCAL FIXTURE BYTES, not of any sealed object. They are what FixtureReader.verify() checks against.
topology_mirrors_production: same six logical Validation-2 table roles and same four reference roles, so the rehearsal proves the real orchestration shape.
version_ids_are_synthetic: VersionId values here are UNMISTAKABLY SYNTHETIC (fixture://...). The real registered S3 VersionIds are deliberately NOT reused: a rehearsal record that carried them could later be misread as having exercised the exact production object versions, which it never did. No S3 version is accessed by a rehearsal.
\u26d4 NOT_A_PRODUCTION_REGISTRY: this registry MUST NOT be usable with --reader s3. The launcher enforces the permitted (reader, window, contract) triples before object construction and before any credential acquisition.
